svg.title: MARS at a glance: three questions, three results computed from real data
svg.desc: Three questions flow into MARS, a set of 55 tested astronomy tools that a person or an AI agent can call, and three results flow out, each computed by MARS from real data in its repository. Optical: a PROMPT-5 image of Centaurus A with the catalogue stars MARS matched, giving a zero point of 21.145 ± 0.012 mag against Skynet's 21.148. Radio: the folded pulse profile of PSR B0329+54 from the Green Bank 20 m telescope, at a blind-search period of 0.7146 s against the catalogue's 0.7145 s. Stars: the colour-magnitude diagram of 548 Gaia DR3 members of M67 with the fitted isochrone, an age of 4.0 Gyr against the literature's 4.3 Gyr.
svg.text: 55 tested astronomy tools that a person or an AI agent can call
the model chooses the steps; tested software computes every number
